# {frontMatter.title}

Use the `{endpoint}` variable to compose your request URL.

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="GET /users" icon="user">
List every user in the workspace. Returns `200 OK` with a JSON array.
  </Card>
  <Card title="POST /users" icon="plus">
Create a new user. The body must include `name` and `email`. Returns `201 Created`.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

Avoid mixing GET and POST parameters in the same call.
